an4.59:1.4: And having given long life, that person partakes of long life, in either the divine or the human realm.
an4.59:1.5: Having given beauty … having given happiness … having given strength, that person partakes of strength, in either the divine or the human realm.
an4.59:1.6: Mendicants, when a donor gives food, that donor gives the recipients these four things.
